notes.title: Update #3 (HOTFIX)
notes.content:
In the last update I clearly messed up, and forgot to test the laser properly. I had nerfed it and it didn't now work where it should have.
Thanks to ZeDoubleJumpz in the Steam reviews to pointing this out, I'm a bit surprised nobody else has brought this to my attention.
This has now been fixed, this update doesn't change anything else.

notes.title: Deathmark Update (update #2)
notes.content:
Here's an update for you.

Added a new quest, the "deathmark" quest:
- Involves the eye and the floating nose, and voodoos.
- Get the mysterious Deathmark.
- Enter the dreams of the dead.
- Investigate dreams and obscurities.
- 2 new achievements.
- One new spell.

Other changes:
- Changed the music of the Sole Isle.

A few small fixes:
- Removed a checkpoint from a place where it shouldn't have been. 
- Made the "Far and Wide" achievement work when actually finding ALL statuesqs, not just most.
- Others...

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
A little update, which addresses some little things in the game.
[list]
[*] Added a singular bat.
[*] Improved the camera’s smoothness by a lot, especially noticeable when falling long distances.
[*] Bats go through platforms now.
[*] Added some more info on how to equip spells in the beginning.
[*] Several little improvements.
[/list]
